539-3821-4679-5231-6023.easyPrerequisites: You control at least two lands excluding Yenna that can tap for mana.
539-3821-4679-5231-6023.description:
Activate up to four lands excluding Yenna by tapping them, adding at least {2}
Activate Yenna by paying {2} and tapping it, creating a token copy of Peregrine Drake
When the Peregrine Drake token enters, it triggers, untapping Yenna and up to four other lands.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Peregrine Drake token, adding {R}.
Repeat

225-983-2645-3430.easyPrerequisites: Stone-Seeder Hierophant doesn't have summoning sickness.
225-983-2645-3430.notablePrerequisites: You control at least five lands.
225-983-2645-3430.description:
Activate Temple of the False God by tapping it, adding six {C} due to Nyxbloom Ancient.
Activate Stone-Seeder Hierophant by tapping it, untapping Temple of the False God
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Stone-Seeder Hierophant.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

4828-5261-7329.easyPrerequisites:
Your deck size is 2 or greater.
Benefactor's Draught is exiled by Isochron Scepter.
Isochron Scepter doesn't have summoning sickness.
4828-5261-7329.notablePrerequisites: Creatures you control can tap to produce at least {2}.
4828-5261-7329.description:
Animate Isochron Scepter using Mind Transfer Protocol.
Activate any number of creatures by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Isochron Scepter by paying {2} and tapping it, casting a copy of Benefactor's Draught without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Benefactor's Draught, untapping all creatures you control and causing you to draw a card
Repeat from step 2.

1339-2438-4616.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature.
1339-2438-4616.description:
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Moldervine Reclamation triggers, causing you to draw a card and gain 1 life.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

628-728-5523.description:
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Defiant Greatmaw.
When Defiant Greatmaw dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When Defiant Greatmaw enters the battlefield, it triggers, putting a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability
Repeat.

23-1651-2392-7839.description:
Cause Orcish Vandal to become an artifact using Silverskin Armor.
Activate Orcish Vandal by tapping it, dealing 2 damage to Smaug.
Smaug triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate Clock of Omens by tapping the Treasures, untapping Orcish Vandal.
Repeat from step 2.

250-779-1479-5411-7893.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
250-779-1479-5411-7893.notablePrerequisites: You have a number of cards in hand that is above your maximum hand size.
250-779-1479-5411-7893.description:
Play Dakmor Salvage.
When Dakmor Salvage enters, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege and Kodama trigger.
Resolve the Kodama trigger, choosing to put nothing onto the battlefield.
Holding priority, activate Need for Speed by sacrificing Dakmor Salvage.
The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
If a land was milled this way, The Gitrog Monster's second ability triggers, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Need for Speed ability
Resolve the Thranduil, Sindarin Liege trigger, creating a token.
When the token enters the battlefield, Kodama triggers, putting Dakmor Salvage from your hand onto the battlefield.
When Dakmor Salvage enters the battlefield, Thranduil, Sindarin Liege triggers.
Repeat from step 4.
Proceed to your cleanup step, and discard Dakmor Salvage and any other card(s) as needed down to your maximum hand size.
The Gitrog Monster triggers, causing you to mill two cards and return Dakmor Salvage from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat, as you will still be over your maximum hand size and will be required to discard again.

849-1580-4871-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Reassembling Skeleton.
When Reassembling Skeleton dies, Pitiless Plunderer and Anax trigger, creating a creature token and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing the creature token.
When the creature token dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Activate the Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{B}.
Activate Reassembling Skeleton by paying {1}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

1850-5414-7705.description:
Activate Troubled Healer by sacrificing a land.
Play the land from your graveyard.
When the land enters, Mole Man triggers, creating a 1/1 Moloid creature token.
Repeat.
1850-5414-7705.notes: If the land can tap for mana once it enters the battlefield, you can do so for infinite mana.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

978-4905-6972.description:
Activate Fanatical Firebrand by tapping it and sacrificing it.
When Fanatical Firebrand dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Vizier of Remedies.
Resolve the Fanatical Firebrand ability.
Repeat.

413-6258--5.description:
Activate Blasting Station by tapping it and sacrificing the persist creature.
When the persist creature dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield without a -1/-1 counter on it due to Thunderous Velocipede.
When the persist creature enters, Blasting Station triggers, untapping Blasting Station.
Resolve the Blasting Station ability from step 1.
Repeat.

5856-5903-7417.easyPrerequisites:
You control an untapped artifact.
You've cast an instant or sorcery spell this turn.
5856-5903-7417.description:
Activate an artifact using Sanar, Unfinished Genius // Wild Idea's ability by tapping it, creating a Treasure token.
Repeat step 1 using the Treasure token.

2103-4823-5144.description:
Cast Capture of Jingzhou by paying its mana cost, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Cast Ephemerate by paying {W}, blinking Timeless Witness and exiling Ephemerate.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Capture of Jingzhou from your graveyard to your hand.
Move to your next turn. At the beginning of your upkeep, Ephemerate's rebound ability triggers, causing you to cast it from exile without paying its mana cost.
Resolve Ephemerate, blinking Timeless Witness.
When Timeless Witness enters, it triggers, returning Ephemerate from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.

1558-2638-3129-3478-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
1558-2638-3129-3478-4231.description:
Play Dimir Aqueduct.
When Dimir Aqueduct enters, it and Tireless Tracker trigger
Resolve the Dimir Aqueduct trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Tracker trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Primal Vigor.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

338-2034-3129-5086-5183.easyPrerequisites: Triskelavus has two or more +1/+1 counters on it.
338-2034-3129-5086-5183.description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate a Triskelavite token by sacrificing it, dealing 1 damage to any target and causing you to gain life.
Triskelavus triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing another creature token, adding {C}{C}
Repeat from step 1.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-5500-6968.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-5500-6968.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Seraphic Steed as attackers.
Seraphic Steed triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

1976-3532-5078-6604.description:
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Clinquant Skymage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {0} and removing a counter from a creature you control.
Repeat.

3661-5220-5683-6798.description:
Activate Umbral Collar Zealot by sacrificing Shield Sphere.
When Shield Sphere dies, Mortuary and Remembrance trigger.
Resolve the Mortuary trigger, putting Shield Sphere from your graveyard on top of your library.
Resolve the Remembrance trigger, searching your library for Shield Sphere and putting it into your hand.
Resolve the Umbral Collar Zealot ability.
Cast Shield Sphere by paying {0}.
Repeat.

560-2558-2981-5727.description:
Cast Sword of the Meek by paying {2}.
When Sword of the Meek enters the battlefield, The Prydwen triggers.
Holding priority, activate Megatog by sacrificing Sword of the Meek.
Resolve the Prydwen trigger, creating a 2/2 Human Knight and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters the battlefield, Sword of the Meek triggers, returning Sword of the Meek from your graveyard to the battlefield attached to the Soldier.
Repeat from step 2.

914-3036-4927.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least five artifacts and/or enchantments.
914-3036-4927.description:
Cast Dockside Extortionist by paying {1}{R}.
When Dockside Extortionist enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating at least five Treasure artifact tokens.
Activate five Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{U}{R}.
Cast Wizard Mentor by paying {2}{U}.
Activate Wizard Mentor by tapping it, returning it and Dockside Extortionist to your hand from the battlefield.
Repeat.
If opponents control at least six artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2438-4435-4550-5567--112.easyPrerequisites: You have two or more cards in hand.
2438-4435-4550-5567--112.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token.
Activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing the Zombie, whose power should have been altered from its base power.
When the Zombie dies, Jason Bright triggers, causing you to draw two cards.
Resolve the Carrion Feeder ability.
Repeat.

4659-5003-5961-6554.manaNeeded: {2} if Mister Gutsy doesn't have a +1/+1 counter on it
4659-5003-5961-6554.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Mister Gutsy, adding {C}{C}.
When Mister Gutsy dies, its second ability and Nim Deathmantle trigger.
Resolve the Mister Gutsy trigger, creating a number of Junk tokens equal to the number of +1/+1 counters that were on it.
If you created a Junk token, activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing a Junk, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the Nim Deathmantle trigger, causing you to pay {4} to return Mister Gutsy from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it, and attaching Nim Deathmantle to it.
Repeat.

575-5624-5686.description:
Activate Shilgengar by sacrificing Nervous Gardener.
When Nervous Gardener dies, Yedora triggers, returning Nervous Gardener from your graveyard to the battlefield face-down as a Forest land.
Resolve the Shilgengar ability
Activate Nervous Gardener by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Nervous Gardener's disguise ability by paying {G}, turning it face-up.
Nervous Gardener triggers, causing you to search your library for a land with a basic land type and put it into your hand.
Repeat.

1785-4894-5003.notablePrerequisites:
Soldevi Adnate does not have summoning sickness.
Nim Deathmantle attached to Breaching Hippocamp.
1785-4894-5003.description:
Activate Soldevi Adnate by tapping it and sacrificing Breaching Hippocamp, adding an amount of {B} equal to Breaching Hippocamp's mana value.
When Breaching Hippocamp dies, Nim Deathmantle triggers, causing you to pay {4} to return Breaching Hippocamp from your graveyard to the battlefield, and attach Nim Deathmantle to it.
When Breaching Hippocamp enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Soldevi Adnate.
Repeat.

654-1170-1770-3389-5954.description:
Cast Flickering Ward by paying {W}.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When Overlord of the Hauntwoods enters the battlefield, it triggers twice, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere land tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping them.
Resolve the Flickering Ward spell.
Activate the two Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {W}{W}.
Activate Flickering Ward by paying {W}, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

3783-4300-5231.description:
Optionally, activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Activate Meloku by paying {1} and returning a land you control to your hand, creating a 1/1 Illusion creature token.
Activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Illusion token, adding {R}.
When the Illusion dies, Minn's second ability triggers, putting a land from your hand onto the battlefield.
Repeat.

1741-4249-5900.notablePrerequisites:
Your devotion to blue or green is at least four.
You control at least one additional mana-producing land that can tap to produce at least {G} or {U}.
1741-4249-5900.description:
Activate Nykthos's second ability by paying {2} and tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G} or {U}{U}{U}{U}.
Activate another mana producing land by tapping it, adding at least {G} or {U}.
Activate Lilysplash Mentor by paying {1}{G}{U}, blinking Cloud of Faeries.
When Cloud of Faeries enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Nykthos and another mana-producing land.
Repeat.
1741-4249-5900.notes: If you have at least five devotion to either blue or green, this combo nets infinite blue or green mana, and you may instead untap any other land(s) in place of Nykthos. If you have at least five devotion to both blue and green, you can forego tapping other land(s) if desired.

2440-2703-3480.description:
Activate Myr Propagator by paying {3} and tapping it, creating a token copy of it.
When the Myr Propagator token enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding {C} for each Myr you control.
Repeat using the Myr Propagator token instead.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

3259-4885-5485.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control
3259-4885-5485.description:
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury and Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger.
Resolve the Orochi Soul-Reaver trigger, creating a Treasure token and causing you to manifest the top card of the damaged opponent's library.
Resolve the Breath of Fury trigger, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the manifested card, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

2178-4410-5136.notablePrerequisites:
All Equipments and/or Auras attached to the same creature.
That creature does not have summoning sickness.
2178-4410-5136.description:
Activate the creature by tapping it, dealing damage to an opponent's creature.
The opponent's creature dies due to deathtouch, triggering the second ability granted by Thornbite Staff, untapping your creature.
Repeat until all opponents' creatures die.
Repeat each time a creature enters the battlefield under an opponent's control.

686-914-2352.notablePrerequisites: Opponents control at least ten artifacts and/or enchantments.
686-914-2352.description:
Activate Cold Storage's first ability twice by paying {6}, exiling Sanctum Gargoyle and Dockside Extortionist from the battlefield.
Activate Cold Storage by sacrificing it, returning Dockside Extortionist and Sanctum Gargoyle from exile to the battlefield.
When Dockside Extortionist and Sanctum Gargoyle enters the battlefield, they trigger.
Resolve the Dockside Extortionist trigger, creating at least ten Treasure artifact tokens.
Resolve the Sanctum Gargoyle trigger, returning Cold Storage from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate ten Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {10}.
Cast Cold Storage by paying {4}.
Repeat.
If opponents control eleven or more artifacts and/or enchantments, this combo nets infinite Treasure tokens and colored mana.

1082-1769-5147.description:
Cast Rot Hulk by paying {5}{B}{B}.
When Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, it and Dual Nature trigger.
Holding priority, activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Rot Hulk.
Dual Nature's second ability triggers, exiling all tokens named Rot Hulk.
Resolve the Goblin Bombardment ability, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Resolve the Rot Hulk trigger from step 2, failing to return anything to the battlefield.
Resolve the Dual Nature trigger from step 2, creating a token copy of Rot Hulk.
When the token copy of Rot Hulk enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Rot Hulk from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.

864-1987-3821.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
864-1987-3821.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake.
When Eternal Witness and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Eternal Witness trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
864-1987-3821.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

283-539-4657.notablePrerequisites:
Magus of the Candelabra does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two mana-producing lands.
283-539-4657.description:
Activate two lands except Magus of the Candelabra by tapping them, adding at least {2}.
Activate Magus of the Candelabra by paying {2} and tapping it, targeting itself and another land you control.
Illusionist's Bracers triggers, copying Magus of the Candelabra's ability, targeting any two lands.
Resolve the copy of Magus of the Candelabra's ability, untapping the two lands.
Activate a land by tapping it, adding at least {1}.
Resolve the original Magus of the Candelabra ability, untapping it and another land you control.
Repeat.

852-2178-3983.notablePrerequisites:
Vhati il-Dal does not have summoning sickness.
Thornbite Staff attached to Vhati il-Dal.
852-2178-3983.description:
Activate Vhati il-Dal by tapping it, causing any other creature to have base toughness 1 until end of turn.
The creature dies as a state-based action due to having zero or less toughness.
Vhati il-Dal triggers, untapping itself.
Repeat.
 You may also repeat this process whenever a creature enters the battlefield.

628-793-1636-2838-3072.notablePrerequisites: Soul Diviner does not have summoning sickness.
628-793-1636-2838-3072.description:
Activate Scorched Rusalka by paying {R} and sacrificing Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Dire Fleet Hoarder triggers, creating a treasure token.
Resolve the Dire Fleet Hoarder's undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Resolve the Sorched Rusalka trigger, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Activate the treasure token by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {R}.
Activate Soul Diviner by tapping it, removing a +1/+1 counter from Dire Fleet Hoarder.
Repeat.
